mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_bookstore_content (original_title, author, genre, content_type, schoolyear, summary, keywords, state, publisher, image_url, reading_time, difficulty) VALUES (#{title}, #{author}, #{genre}, #{contentType}, #{schoolYear}, #{summary}, #{keywords}, #{state}, #{publisher}, #{imageUrl}, #{readingTime}, #{difficulty})
INSERT INTO erp_bookstore_item (bcode, content_id, book_title, author, publisher, image_url) VALUES (#{bcode}, #{contentId}, #{bookTitle}, #{author}, #{publisher}, #{imageUrl})

INSERT INTO erp_bookstore_item_del (deleted_by, bcode, content_id, book_title, author, publisher, image_url, center_code, quantity, state) SELECT #{deletedBy}, i.bcode, i.content_id, i.book_title, i.author, i.publisher, i.image_url, ic.center_code, ic.quantity, ic.state FROM erp_bookstore_item i JOIN erp_bookstore_item_center ic ON i.bcode = ic.bcode WHERE i.bcode = #{bcode} AND ic.center_code = #{centerCode}

INSERT INTO erp_bookstore_item (bcode, content_id, book_title, author, publisher, image_url) SELECT bcode, content_id, book_title, author, publisher, image_url FROM erp_bookstore_item_del WHERE del_id = #{delId}

INSERT INTO erp_bookstore_item_center (bcode, center_code, quantity, state) SELECT bcode, center_code, ISNULL(quantity, 0), state FROM erp_bookstore_item_del WHERE del_id = #{delId} AND center_code IS NOT NULL
mapper.select:
SELECT bc.content_id, bc.original_title, bc.author, bc.genre, g.codeNm AS genre_name, bc.content_type, ct.codeNm AS content_type_name, bc.schoolyear, s.codeNm AS schoolyear_name, bc.summary, bc.keywords, bc.state, bc.publisher, bc.image_url, bc.reading_time, bc.difficulty FROM erp_bookstore_content bc LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_code g ON g.gubun = 'G' AND g.code = bc.genre LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_code s ON s.gubun = 'S' AND s.code = bc.schoolyear LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_code ct ON ct.gubun = 'C' AND ct.code = bc.content_type
AND bc.original_title LIKE '%' + #{title} + '%' AND bc.author LIKE '%' + #{author} + '%' AND bc.genre = #{genre} AND bc.schoolyear = #{schoolYear} AND bc.keywords LIKE '%' + #{keyword} + '%' AND bc.content_type = #{contentType} AND bc.state = #{state}
SELECT TOP 1 content_id FROM erp_bookstore_content WHERE original_title = #{title}

SELECT i.bcode, i.content_id, i.book_title, i.author, i.publisher, i.image_url, bc.center_code, bc.state FROM erp_bookstore_item i LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_item_center bc ON i.bcode = bc.bcode WHERE i.bcode = #{bcode}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_bookstore_item_center (bcode, center_code, quantity, state) VALUES (#{bcode}, #{centerCode}, #{quantity}, #{state})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM erp_bookstore_item_center WHERE bcode = #{bcode} AND center_code = #{centerCode}
mapper.select: SELECT del_id, deleted_at, deleted_by, bcode, content_id, book_title, author, publisher, image_url, center_code, quantity, state FROM erp_bookstore_item_del ORDER BY deleted_at DESC

SELECT ic.bcode, ic.center_code, ic.quantity, ic.state, ic.registered_at, i.content_id, i.book_title, i.author, i.publisher, i.image_url FROM erp_bookstore_item_center ic JOIN erp_bookstore_item i ON ic.bcode = i.bcode WHERE ic.center_code = #{centerCode} ORDER BY ic.registered_at DESC
